MODULE_NOTES: One panel along the bottom of the screen: your portrait, the game menu, the experience bar, money and bags.
CMD_PORTRAIT: face or live: your portrait as a picture or as a live 3D head
PANEL_HEIGHT_TIP: The panel's height. Its buttons, icons and bar grow with it.
PANEL_CHARBUTTON_TIP: Your portrait with your level in the screen's corner, or a menu button with your face.
PANEL_MICROICONS_TIP: Blizzard's icons scaled to one size, or the same icons in one gold colour.
SECTION_ITEMS_TIP: The screen's edge with the panel's three zones. Drag an item into a zone, or down into «Not on the panel»: then it stands alone, placed in the placing mode.
PANEL_MICROON_TIP: The game menu buttons. The bottom panel's zones or the placing mode decide where they are.
PANEL_STATUSON_TIP: The experience and reputation bars. The bottom panel's zones or the placing mode decide where they are.
PANEL_BOTTOMON_TIP: A panel along the screen's edge: menu, bars, gold, bags.
PANEL_OUTLINE_TIP: Around the panel's text: the time, the zone, the money.
PANEL_SHADOW_TIP: A dark shadow under the panel's text.
PANEL_EDGE_TIP: Which edge of the screen the panel runs along.
PANEL_FIT_TIP: The whole edge, or as long as its buttons, centred.
PANEL_RESTING_TIP: In an inn or a city.
PANEL_FADEDALPHA_TIP: How visible the panel is while hidden. A hidden panel takes no clicks, even when you can see it.
PANEL_CONDITION_TIP: A macro condition that decides alone, such as [combat] hide; show. Empty: the settings above decide.
PANEL_MICROMENU_TIP: Character, spellbook, talents, quest log and the game's other menu buttons.
PANEL_EXPERIENCE_TIP: Experience and rested bonus; at the level cap, the reputation chosen for the experience bar.
PANEL_ZONE_TIP: The zone you're in. It shows in one place only: here means not on the minimap.
PANEL_CLOCK_TIP: The clock; orange while calendar invites wait. It shows in one place only: here means not on the minimap.
PANEL_CURRENCIES_TIP: Gold and the currencies marked to show on the backpack (the Currency tab).
PANEL_BAGS_TIP: The backpack and bag slots with their free space.
PANEL_XPFILL_TIP: The texture that fills the experience bar.
PANEL_BARSON_TIP: Ordaen's action bars in place of Blizzard's.
PANEL_BARSMODE_TIP: Classic: Blizzard's eight bars, each on its own page of slots, so the game's bars show the same without the addon. Free: your own bars of any size.
PANEL_BARS_PERROW_TIP: The bar wraps into rows of this many buttons.
PANEL_BARS_SCALE_TIP: The bar's size, its buttons and gaps together.
PANEL_BARS_KEYS_TIP: The key bound to each button, in its corner.
PANEL_BARS_MACROS_TIP: A macro's name under its icon.
PANEL_BARS_EMPTY_TIP: On: empty buttons always show. Off: only while you drag a spell.
PANEL_BARS_SHOWOOC_TIP: Show the bar out of combat.
PANEL_BARS_FADEOOC_TIP: How visible the bar is while the mouse isn't over it. Over it, the bar shows in full.
PANEL_BARS_DELAYOOC_TIP: How long the bar stays in full after the mouse leaves it.
PANEL_BARS_THROUGHOOC_TIP: Clicks on the bar reach the world under it. Keys still press its buttons.
PANEL_BARS_FADECOMBAT_TIP: How visible the bar is while the mouse isn't over it. Over it, the bar shows in full.
PANEL_BARS_DELAYCOMBAT_TIP: How long the bar stays in full after the mouse leaves it.
PANEL_BARS_THROUGHCOMBAT_TIP: Clicks on the bar reach the world under it. Keys still press its buttons.
PANEL_BARS_SHOWTRANSPORT_TIP: Show the bar on transport (a flight path or a vehicle).
PANEL_BARS_FADETRANSPORT_TIP: How visible the bar is while the mouse isn't over it. Over it, the bar shows in full.
PANEL_BARS_DELAYTRANSPORT_TIP: How long the bar stays in full after the mouse leaves it.
PANEL_BARS_THROUGHTRANSPORT_TIP: Clicks on the bar reach the world under it. Keys still press its buttons.
